description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。


> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**可能不一样。
description.en:
A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value on your client. The value must contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. Each API request may have a different **RequestId**.

description.zh:
DNS授权规则描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`。
description.en:
A description of the DNS authorization rule.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
DNS授权规则名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the DNS authorization rule.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
目标DNS授权规则IP地址。

> 当**ServiceType**参数取值为**DNSRedirect**时，该参数必选。
description.en:
The destination IP address of the DNS authorization rule.

> This parameter is required when **ServiceType** is set to **DNSRedirect**.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- **true**：发送检查请求，不会创建DNS授权规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行创建。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Performs a check. No DNS authorization rule is created. The system checks required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, the system returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, the system returns the error code `DryRunOperation`.

- **false** (default): Performs the operation. After passing the check, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and creates the DNS authorization rule.
The ID of the IoT Cloud Connector instance group.

description.zh:
云连接器实例组所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[ListRegions](~~313836~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the IoT Cloud Connector instance group.

You can call the [ListRegions](~~313836~~) operation to query region IDs.

description.zh:
DNS授权规则的目标类型。取值：

- **Normal**：表示目标类型为DNS普通类型。

- **DNSRedirect**：表示目标类型为DNS重定向类型。
description.en:
The target type of the DNS authorization rule. Valid values:

- **Normal**: The target type is normal DNS.

- **DNSRedirect**: The target type is DNS redirection.

description.zh:

**100.100.2.136**，**100.100.2.137**，**100.100.2.138**，**114.114.114.114**，**8.8.8.8**，**8.8.4.4**，**223.5.5.5**，**223.6.6.6**，**221.5.88.88**，**116.116.116.116**，**221.228.15.26**，**61.139.2.69**，**218.6.200.139**，**119.29.29.29**，**218.2.2.2**，**208.67.220.220**，**208.67.222.222**，**218.4.4.4**。

**100.100.2.136**, **100.100.2.137**, **100.100.2.138**, **114.114.114.114**, **8.8.8.8**, **8.8.4.4**, **223.5.5.5**, **223.6.6.6**, **221.5.88.88**, **116.116.116.116**, **221.228.15.26**, **61.139.2.69**, **218.6.200.139**, **119.29.29.29**, **218.2.2.2**, **208.67.220.220**, **208.67.222.222**, and **218.4.4.4**.
